name: Spider-Power
description: Swing fists forward to strike, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer.

stats.DAMAGE: The first two strikes deal 25 damage, while the third strike deals 40 damage (damage increases for one strike when hitting with Spider-Tracer) Midair strikes are an overhead slam that deal 55 damage
stats.INTERVAL: The first two strikes have an interval of 0.37s between them, while the third strike has a 0.82s interval from the second strike
stats.MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The first two strikes can hit up to 3m, while the third strike can hit up to 4m

name: Web Cluster
description: Shoot a Web-Cluster that deals damage and attaches a Spider-Tracer to the hit enemy.

stats.CASTING: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory
stats.DAMAGE: 30 (consuming Spider-Tracer with another ability deals a further 45)
stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 50% at 40m

name: Spectacular Spin
description: Launch Web-Clusters all around to damage and Stun enemies.

name: Web-Swing
description: Shoot a strand of webbing to swing.

name: Get Over Here!
description: Shoot webbing to reel in the hit enemy. If the enemy is tagged with a Spider-Tracer, Spider-Man will get pulled to them instead.

stats.CASTING: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory

name: Amazing Combo
description: Launch an enemy upward, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer.

stats.DAMAGE: 70 (damage increases for one strike when hitting with Spider-Tracer)

name: Wall Crawl
description: Press {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = Space | PS5 = link=| | Xbox = link=|}} to wall crawl, and while crawling, press {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = Left-Click | PS5 = link=| | Xbox =  link=|}} to sprint.

name: Spider-Sense
description: Give a warning of enemies that have been around.

name: Sticky Spider-Bomb
description: Cyber-Spiders Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health.
